preamble.summary: 2 Kings shares manuscript attestation with 1 Kings — the same Cave 4, 5, and 6 papyrus fragments preserve scattered material. Coverage is light. Where readings can be reconstructed, the DSS broadly agrees with MT.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The DSS does not directly bear on the Hezekiah-Sennacherib parallel between 2 Kings 18-20 and Isaiah 36-39 (which 1QIsaᵃ does illuminate from the Isaiah side).
preamble.coverage_assessment: fragmentary; ~50 verses attested across the listed manuscripts.
